content:
Donald Trump went on a tangent while pardoning turkeys on Tuesday to ask why Republicans got drubbed in the 2026 midterms, and his critics were only too happy to explain.

During the annual Thanksgiving ceremony outside the White House, Trump gave a shoutout to West Virginia turkey farmers Scott and Becky Rightsell, who raised this year’s presidential turkeys, named Freedom and Feathers.

And then he made it about himself.

“We won West Virginia by 45 points. At least I did when I was on the ballot,” Trump said. “I don’t know what happened. I won it by a lot. I don’t know what the hell happened with this last election, can somebody please explain it to me?”

Critics were more than happy to oblige:
